page_title: HEI 1-2 DOR | Heidenheim v Dortmund 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' A quickly taken corner by Dortmund.
90+3' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Frank Willenborg ignores the protests.
90+1' Yellow card! It's like Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Frank Willenborg agrees and books him.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' The corner is swung in but Heidenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.
88' A yellow card for a tackle by Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund). Frank Willenborg doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
87' Mike Tullberg decides to make a substitution. Jamie Gittens will be replaced by Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund).
87' Yan Couto (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Karim Adeyemi.
85' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is ready and denies him.
84' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
83' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
82' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:15.
80' Benedikt Gimber will be replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
78' Nightmare of a shot. Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) is first to a rebound inside the 6-yard box but his shot goes high and wide of the goal.
78' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
77' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
76' Dortmund can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
76' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
75' The attendance for today's match is 15000.
74' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
74' It will be a corner kick for Heidenheim.
73' Here is a change. Frans Kratzig is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Paul Wanner (Heidenheim).
71' That will be all from Pascal Gross who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Salih Ozcan (Dortmund).
68' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) makes a strong challenge and Frank Willenborg blows for a foul.
66' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Gregor Kobel has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
64' 1 - 2 What a brilliant finish! Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and fires the ball past the helpless goalkeeper.
63' 0 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) was set free in the area by Ramy Bensebaini and fired past Kevin Muller. 0:2.
58' Mike Tullberg has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) replacing Julian Brandt.
58' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
57' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) meets a precise pass with a nice touch on the edge of the box and produces a shot to the middle of the goal. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
56' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Marvin Pieringer walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim).
56' Leo Scienza goes off the pitch and Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) comes on.
55' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Luca Kerber is replaced by Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
48' Dangerous play by Julian Brandt (Dortmund). Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Julien Duranville will not participate anymore and Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) is coming on.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
41' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
38' Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
33' 0 - 1 Goal! Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
32' Dortmund force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
30' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
27' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) outjumps the defence to meet a whipped in cross. It's a fine looking effort towards the middle of the goal, but Kevin Muller reacts well to deny him.
25' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
23' The possession of the ball – 16:84.
20' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) commits a rough foul. Frank Willenborg stops the game and makes a call.
16' Gregor Kobel blocks Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim)'s effort from the edge of the box.
14' Frank Willenborg has issued a yellow card to Julien Duranville (Dortmund).
14' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
10' None of the Dortmund players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
10' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
6' The cross into the penalty area from Julien Duranville (Dortmund) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
2' Frank Willenborg couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Julien Duranville (Dortmund) and blew his whistle.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Dortmund will kick-off.
Frank Willenborg is introduced as the referee for today's match.
